title: Add and subtract integers
status: draft: written by Claude, waiting for owner review
about: Teacher-verified mastery check. Written separately from the practice generators: different wordings, word problems, and an 'is this right?' item. Each item is worth 1 point. 'math' is the calculation behind the item, used only by the test that checks the answer key.
directions: Show your work. A number line counts as work.

items.prompt: At 6 a.m. it was −4°F. By noon the temperature had gone up 11 degrees. What was the temperature at noon?
Jaylen says 5 − (−3) = 2. Is Jaylen right? Explain, and give the correct answer.
A diver is at −30 feet (30 feet below the surface). She swims up 12 feet. What is her new position?
Your bank account has $15. You spend $40 with your debit card. What is your balance now?
